request: Review the new preview route for correctness against our account isolation requirement. Do not edit.

artifacts.change.diff: The verified base contains load_account and export exactly as shown. This change adds only preview (lines 9-10).
artifacts.AGENTS.md: Every public data route must reject a request for another account before reading data. Both export and preview are public routes with an authenticated actor and caller-selected account_id. Authorization is owned by load_account, which rejects mismatches before any store call; duplicating it in routes is not required.
artifacts.observations.txt: Tests on the reviewed head cover same-account reads and mismatched accounts through preview and export. Mismatches raise PermissionError with zero store.read calls. All pass. There is no changed behavior outside the supplied route.
